Invisalign Service at Clearwater, FL

BOOK ONLINE

Feel Confident With Invisalign

If your teeth are crooked or misaligned, don't feel discouraged; approximately 9 out of 10 individuals suffer from some degree of misalignment. While misalignments may only seem aesthetic at first, crookedness can have serious ramifications for both oral and overall health. For example, overlapping can make cleaning the surface difficult, leading to decay or gum disease occurring more readily than expected.


Correcting misalignment was once only achievable through traditional metal braces; approximately 4 million Americans wear them at any one time to achieve straighter, healthier smiles. But thanks to modern advances, no longer must one rely on metal braces alone to straighten your teeth; at Clearwater Dentist located in Clearwater, FL, with the help of our dental team, you can achieve both beauty and health with Invisalign!


We love seeing our patients regain their self-confidence with each visit while straightening their teeth; one of the benefits of Invisalign is achieving a perfect smile with a beautiful appearance!

 

Continue reading to gain more insight into Invisalign treatment. Want to book an initial consultation appointment? Get in touch now!

Get Proven Results from Our Experts

Since 1997, when Invisalign aligners were first made available on the market by the FDA-approved orthodontic device manufacturer Align Technology Inc, millions worldwide have experienced incredible transformation through this revolutionary treatment! Now is your opportunity to experience this too!

 

Clearwater Dentist's experienced team is committed to helping you realize the smile of your dreams. Simply schedule a consultation at our dental office, and our experts will conduct a comprehensive examination before designing custom-made aligners tailored specifically to meet your unique requirements and start your treatment journey.

What is Invisalign?

Invisalign provides a modern solution for correcting misalignments of teeth. Unlike traditional braces that attach metal brackets and wires directly to your teeth, Invisalign utilizes custom-made clear aligner trays worn over your teeth that apply controlled pressure gradually to move their position - similar to traditional braces but more discreet! With consistent use you may start seeing results as early as several weeks!

 

Crafted from high-grade plastic, Invisalign aligner trays are custom tailored to perfectly align with the teeth of each patient. By employing advanced diagnostic imaging, Dr. Nadia can accurately ascertain the duration and progress of your treatment; additionally we utilize 3D computer modeling technology to display its progression; giving a glimpse into your future smile!

What Are the Benefits of Invisalign?

One of the main advantages of Invisalign can be seen by its name alone: invisible aligners. Many patients value its discreet nature compared to traditional metal braces. Aside from being virtually undetectable, Invisalign aligner trays also provide numerous additional benefits:

 

●    Easy to remove and put on yourself

●    Thin and lightweight

●    Designed for a comfortable fit

●    Easy to keep clean

●    Easy to use with fewer visits to the dentist


The best part is that Invisalign isn’t just for children and teenagers. Adults can use Invisalign aligners to achieve a straighter smile, too!

Frequently Asked Questions

How is Invisalign different from traditional braces?

Invisalign uses clear plastic, removeable aligners that are more esthetic, but they are completely dependent on patient compliance. Traditional braces are not removeable and they are ugly.

What are the benefits of choosing Invisalign over metal braces?

Invisalign does not have food restrictions, easy home hygiene, and they are virtually invisible.

Does financing cover the cost of Invisalign treatment?

Yes. In fact, many financing providers have lower interest rates for Invisalign. 

Can I remove my Invisalign aligners when eating or drinking?

Yes.   

How much does Invisalign cost?

Cost for Invisalign varies depending on treatment complexity. Treatments start at $4,500 in our office.
